The native 24-bit random generator uses the algorithm described by the MIT-licensed Microsoft.VisualBasic VBMath implementation (dotnet/runtime). The C++ state/host/lifetime integration is LinAccess code. This is a public algorithm reference, not an Access execution oracle.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/libraries/Microsoft.VisualBasic.Core/src/Microsoft/VisualBasic/VBMath.vb
